kurz: The fat droplets run back together. Usually it was too hot or the fat went in too fast.
bild_im_kopf: Like a party where everyone retreats to their old cliques: fat to fat, water to water.

ursachen.warum: Heat makes butter [[emulsion|emulsions]] melt and egg yolk curdle. The fat seeps out.
fix: Vigorously stir in a spoonful of cold water or cream

ursachen.warum: The [[emulgator|emulsifier]] cannot keep up with coating the droplets.
fix: Start again in a new bowl with a little water or egg yolk
Work in the split sauce drop by drop

ursachen.warum: Too much fat for too little egg yolk, mustard or starch.
fix: Add mustard or a little pasta water

q1.frage: Was the sauce on the heat when it split?

q2.frage: Did you add the fat quickly?
